timestamp_evidence.basis: Publisher code parses ts_epoch as milliseconds. Native ts_dt values are separately checked against that UTC interpretation.

water.label: Publisher water device family; cold-water stream

unit_review.note: Public release names the hardware but does not explicitly identify the numeric volume unit. No litre conversion is inferred.

hotWater.label: Publisher hotWater device family; separate hot-water stream

unit_review.note: Hydraulic relationship to water is unresolved. Never sum the two into a household total automatically.

scope_policy: One component per canonical import environment. Field installations only; lab, ambient, electricity and heatCoolingLoadMeter are excluded.
aggregation_review: Hour/day boundaries generally fall between counter samples. The core does not invent within-interval allocation; cross-bucket volume remains unallocated and coverage unknown. A daily forecast target needs a separate reviewed policy.
